critical_code_review_comments: staff_portal.py:342 — qr_ok compares to (attendance_qr_token or '\x00'). Safe placeholder, but if a tenant's token happens to be empty string, an attacker sending qr_token:'\x00' would still fail (0-byte != \x00). Consider explicit 'if not t.get("attendance_qr_token"): qr_ok=False' for clarity.

staff_portal.py:353 — 'if distance_m is None and not qr_ok: penalty=0.0'. When the salon has NO geo-fence configured (f_lat None) AND the staff sends no lat/lng and no qr_token, check-in currently succeeds and only zeroes the fine. That's probably intended for salons without a fence, but note there's no auditable proof of on-site presence in that case.

staff_portal.py:466 run_half_day_noshow_marker iterates ALL active staff across ALL tenants in a single loop and uses each staff's own shift_start with the same now_ist. Correct, but O(N) per run — fine for now, watch as tenant count grows.

registry.py:568 — 'if len(digits) >= 10' path relies on regex $ anchor to last 10 digits; works for +91/91 prefixes. However if a staff row's phone field contains formatting (spaces/dashes), the regex won't match. Consider normalising phone on write.
